hero.title: AI-designed outfits, sent to you to quote.
hero.description: Customers design outfits in the Qlozet studio and send them to tailors they choose. Each one reaches you as a quote request, ready to price.

detail.title: The whole design, spelled out
detail.description: Open a request to see the version to make, the style choices, the fabric and the customer's note. Other versions they liked are there for ideas.
points: Style choices listed one by one

status.title: Quote it, and win the order
status.description: Send your price and the days you need. When the customer accepts, they pay a deposit and the request becomes an order.
points: Save a draft, send when ready
Your quote shown on the request
A deposit paid when they choose you

styles.title: AI images for your own styles
styles.description: Add the necklines, sleeves and finishes you offer to your style library. Upload a photo or sketch, or describe the style and generate an image with AI.
points: Name it, describe it, generate it
Each image uses a few tokens
